mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower rates predict positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% compared to when it is above (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4.5% and annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high demand growth (GDPC1 growth rate > 3% and HOUST > 1200), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 and the regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 3% and HOUST > 1200) is active (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4.5%, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current industrial production (INDPRO) is positively related to S&P 500 forward returns: higher industrial production predicts positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when INDPRO is above 100 compared to when it is below (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 370000 and the regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) is active (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
